rationale: The agent verified the user via email using the tool, then retrieved user and order details read-only. It listed prior order addresses so the user could select the Washington, DC address without revealing it directly. After receiving “yes,” it performed address updates only on pending orders and not on delivered or processed ones. Tool outputs confirm the correct changes.
